shots.line: Northern lights glow above the dark rooftops of Helsinki.
At Lapinlahdenkatu 16 stands Saidot, an AI governance company founded in 2018 by Meeri Haataja.
Here, a team of 11 to 50 people maps AI models, agents, and datasets to risks and policies.
Saidot raised 1.75 million euros in 2023 from Crowberry Capital, Ventic, and Business Finland.
In November 2026, the company also raised an undisclosed round of funding.
